channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Booliska Jubaland oo Kismaayo ku qabtay afar qof oo lagu tuhmay tahriib loo wado Liibiya
item.description: Ciidanka booliska Jubaland ayaa Arbacadii garoonka diyaaradaha ee Kismaayo ku qabtay afar qof oo lagu tuhmay inay ku lug lahaayeen qorshe dhallinyaro loogu tahriibinayay dibadda, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Juan Mata oo 38 jir ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubbadda cagta
item.description: Juan Mata, oo la guuleystay Spain Koobka Adduunka 2010 iyo Euro 2012, ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubbadda cagta isagoo 38 jir ah, kaddib 20 xilli ciyaareed, sida ay werisay AS.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo keligeed ka hor timid qaraar Qaramada Midoobay ka ansixisay difaaca haweenka iyo gabdhaha – Codka haweenka oo mar kale dunida xusuusiyay muhiimaddooda!
item.description: Guddiga saddexaad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa 175 cod ku ansixiyey qaraar lagu xoojinayo dagaalka ka dhanka ah tacaddiyada haweenka iyo gabdhaha, halka Soomaaliya ay noqotay dalka keliya ee diiday.

item.title: Pochettino oo Arbacada bilaabaya shaqada Man Utd: "Manchester had iyo jeer buluug ma ahaan doonto"
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino ayaa ballanqaaday inuu Manchester United dib ugu celin doono inay noqoto kooxda ugu guulaha badan magaalada, isagoo Arbacadan si rasmi ah u bilaabaya shaqadiisa cusub, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Voyager 1 oo gaartay masaafo hal maalin iftiin ah oo u jirta Dhulka
item.description: Dayax-gacmeedka sahanka ee Voyager 1 ayaa Arbacadii gaaray masaafo hal maalin iftiin ah oo u jirta Dhulka, taasoo ah qiyaastii 25.9 bilyan oo kiilomitir, kaddib ku dhawaad 50 sano oo uu hawada sare ku jiray, sida ay werisay Sweden Herald iyadoo soo xiganaysa NASA.

item.title: Talyaaniga oo ansixiyay sharci ka dhan ah naceybka Yuhuudda, iyadoo walaac laga muujiyay xorriyadda hadalka
item.description: Xildhibaannada Talyaaniga ayaa Talaadadii ansixiyay sharci lagula dagaallamayo naceybka Yuhuudda, kaasoo sharciga dalka ku daraya qeexidda ururka IHRA ee 2016, inkastoo mucaaradku ay ka cabsi qabaan inuu xaddido xorriyadda hadalka, sida ay werisay The Local iyo France 24.

item.title: Qarax xooggan oo laga maqlay waqooyiga magaalada Riyadh
item.description: Qarax xooggan ayaa Arbacadii laga maqlay qeybta waqooyi ee Riyadh, caasimadda Sacuudi Carabiya, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AFP. Sababta qaraxa iyo haddii uu khasaare dhaliyay lama oga weli.

item.title: Real Madrid oo loo soo jeediyay ganaax 3,001 euro ah boodh ka dhan ah Javier Tebas dartiis
item.description: Guddiga Spain ee la dagaalanka rabshadaha isboortiga ayaa soo jeediyay in Real Madrid la ganaaxo 3,001 euro, kaddib markii taageerayaasheedu garoonka Bernabéu ku muujiyeen boodh ka dhan ah madaxweynaha LaLiga, Javier Tebas, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Chile iyo Colombia oo 0-0 ku kala tagay, Vigouroux oo badbaadiyay rigoore
item.description: Xulalka Chile iyo Colombia ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Monumental ee Santiago ku kala tagay barbarro 0-0 ah, kulankoodii saaxiibtinimo ee ugu dambeeyay sannadkan, iyadoo goolhayaha Chile, Lawrence Vigouroux, uu badbaadiyay rigoore, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: AFL oo 3 kulan ka joojisay Tom Papley kaddib baaritaan muujiyay kookayn iyo MDMA
item.description: Ururka kubbadda cagta Australia (AFL) ayaa 3 kulan ka joojiyay xiddigga Sydney Swans, Tom Papley, kaddib markii muunad labaad oo baaritaan daroogo ah ay xaqiijisay kookayn iyo MDMA, sida ay werisay The Guardian.

item.title: Turkiga: diyaaradaha F-16 ee Soomaaliya oo 55 saacadood ku kala duulay Muqdisho iyo Bandırma
item.description: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in duuliyeyaasheeda ay diyaaradaha dagaalka F-16 ee ka howlgala Soomaaliya ku kala beddeleen Muqdisho iyo magaalada Bandırma, iyagoo maray in ka badan 11,000 oo kiiloomitir muddo 55 saacadood ah.

item.title: Quentin Grimes oo 47 dhibcood dhaliyay, Lakers oo 118-114 ku garaacday Hornets waqti dheeraad ah
item.description: Quentin Grimes ayaa dhaliyay 47 dhibcood, oo ah kuwii ugu badnaa xirfaddiisa, isagoo Los Angeles Lakers ka caawiyay inay waqti dheeraad ah 118-114 kaga adkaadaan Charlotte Hornets, sida ay werisay The Athletic iyo AP.

item.title: Aadan Faarax oo loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha guddiga maamulka Ethiopian Airlines
item.description: Aadan Faarax, oo ah siyaasi Soomaali ah oo haya darajada Ra’iisul Wasaare-ku-xigeenka Itoobiya, ayaa loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha cusub ee guddiga maamulka shirkadda diyaaradaha Ethiopian Airlines, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Kozo Tashima oo si rasmi ah u gudbiyay codsigiisa doorashada madaxweynaha FIFA
item.description: Kozo Tashima, madaxweynaha sharafta ee Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Japan, ayaa gudbiyay codsigiisa uu ugu tartamayo madaxweynaha FIFA, kaddib markii ay taageereen 5 xiriir oo qaran, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo xarigga ka jaray waddada Jamhuuriya ee degmada Kaaraan
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Arbacadii xarigga ka jaray waddada Jamhuuriya ee degmada Kaaraan ee Muqdisho, kaddib dib-u-dhis iyo dayactir ballaaran oo lagu sameeyay, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Ecuador oo 2-0 ku garaacday Bolivia, Gallardo oo gaaray guushiisii labaad
item.description: Xulka Ecuador ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Monumental ee Guayaquil 2-0 kaga adkaaday Bolivia kulan saaxiibtinimo ah, taas oo ahayd guushii labaad ee isku xigta ee tababaraha cusub Marcelo Gallardo, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Euro 2028: dheriyada isreebreebka oo la ogaaday, France iyo England oo ku jira dheriga 1
item.description: Kaddib dhammaadka wareegga koowaad ee UEFA Nations League, waxaa la ogaaday dheriyada isreebreebka Euro 2028, iyadoo France, England, Spain iyo Germany ay ku jiraan dheriga 1, sida ay werisay RMC Sport.

item.title: Endrick: "Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan noloshayda oo dhan ku qaato Real Madrid"
item.description: Weeraryahanka reer Brazil ee Real Madrid, Endrick, ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo inuu noloshiisa oo dhan ku qaato kooxda, xilli warbaahinta Spain ay sheegayso inuu ka fikirayo inuu ka tago bisha January.

item.title: Mexico oo 1-0 ku garaacday Jamaica, semi-finalka Nations League-na kula kulmi doonta Mareykanka
item.description: Xulka Mexico ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Monterrey 1-0 kaga adkaaday Jamaica, isagoo isugeyn ahaan 3-3 ku gaaray kuna gudbay semi-finalka CONCACAF Nations League, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono Mareykanka.

item.title: Detroit Pistons oo 105-93 ku jebiyay 12-kii guulood ee isku xigay ee San Antonio Spurs
item.description: Detroit Pistons ayaa garoonka San Antonio 105-93 kaga adkaaday Spurs, taasoo soo afjartay 12 guulood oo isku xigay oo kooxda Victor Wembanyama ay ka gaartay horyaalka NBA.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga oo ka wada hadlay mataanaynta caasimadaha Muqdisho iyo Riyaad
item.description: Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Sacuudi Carabiya, Maxamed Amiin Sheekh Cusmaan, ayaa kulan la qaatay Duqa Magaalada Riyaad, Amiir Dr. Faysal Bin Cabdulcasiis Bin Cayaaf, iyagoo ka wada hadlay qorshe lagu mataaneynayo labada caasimadood.

item.title: Xi Jinping iyo Putin oo Shenzhen ku kulmay maalin ka hor shir saddex geesood ah oo Trump ka qayb galayo
item.description: Madaxweynaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin ayaa Arbacada wada hadal ku yeeshay magaalada Shenzhen, maalin ka hor shir aan horay u dhicin oo saddex geesood ah oo ay la yeelanayaan madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump.

item.title: Waymo oo hakisay safarrada gawaarida aan darawalka lahayn ee waddooyinka waaweyn ee Mareykanka
item.description: Shirkadda Waymo ayaa hakisay adeegga tagsiyada aan darawalka lahayn ee waddooyinka xawaaraha sare ee dhammaan suuqyada Mareykanka, kaddib markii California ay si ku meel gaar ah uga mamnuucday waddooyinkeeda waaweyn.

item.title: Cutter Gauthier oo noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay ee NHL ee hal bil gudaheed sameeya 4 hat-trick
item.description: Weeraryahanka Anaheim Ducks, Cutter Gauthier, ayaa noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay taariikhda NHL ee sameeya 4 hat-trick hal bil oo kalandar ah, sida ay werisay The Athletic, inkastoo Ducks ay 8-6 ku lumiyeen kulankii St. Louis Blues.

item.title: Cricket Australia oo madal madaxbannaan u furtay ciyaartoyda fadeexadda sandpapergate
item.description: Cricket Australia ayaa furtay madal madaxbannaan oo ciyaartoyda iyo shaqaalihii ku lug lahaa fadeexaddii xumeynta kubbadda ee 2018, ee loo yaqaan sandpapergate, ay ku sheegi karaan sida ay wax u dhaceen.

item.title: Mary Peltola oo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Alaska, Dan Sullivan oo laga adkaaday
item.description: Musharaxa Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Mary Peltola ayaa ka adkaatay Senator Dan Sullivan oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Jamhuuriga, iyadoo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee gobolka Alaska, kaas oo ahaa doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee Golaha Guurtida ee la go'aamiyo, sida ay saadaaliyeen warbaahinta Mareykanka.

item.title: Connor Bedard oo dhaawac la baxay, Blackhawks oo 6-3 ku garaacay Maple Leafs
item.description: Xiddigga kooxda Chicago Blackhawks Connor Bedard ayaa Talaadadii dhaawac ku ah garoonka ka baxay xilli uu socday kulan ay kooxdiisu 6-3 kaga adkaatay Toronto Maple Leafs horyaalka NHL.

item.title: Nin Pakistani ah oo 27 sano iyo badh lagu xukumay qorshe lagu doonayay in lagu dilo siyaasiyiin Mareykan ah
item.description: Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taal Brooklyn ayaa Talaadadii 330 bilood oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Asif Merchant, oo u dhashay Pakistan, kaddib markii lagu helay qorshe dil oo uu sheegay inuu ka dambeeyay Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, Donald Trump-na uu ka mid ahaa bartilmaameedyada.

item.title: Stojakovic oo 46 dhibcood dhaliyay, Illinois oo 99-78 ku garaacday Duke
item.description: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Illinois, oo kaalinta 10-aad ah, ayaa Talaadadii 99-78 kaga adkaatay Duke oo kaalinta 5-aad ah garoonkeeda Cameron Indoor Stadium, iyadoo Andrej Stojakovic uu dhaliyay 46 dhibcood.

item.title: Mareykanka oo 2-0 ku garaacay Haiti kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee Pochettino
item.description: Xulka Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cincinnati 2-0 kaga adkaaday Haiti, isagoo isugeyn ahaan 8-0 ugu gudbay semi-finalka CONCACAF Nations League, kulankaas oo ahaa kii ugu dambeeyay ee tababare Mauricio Pochettino.
